name: Fish in bamboo
summary: Cá lam ống is fish cooked in a bamboo tube, served at Xá Phó family meals in Nậm Sang, about 30 km south of town.
origin: Xá Phó households of thôn Nậm Sang, xã Nậm Sài.
howToEat: Eat it as part of the home meal, with the bamboo-shoot dishes and black pork.
where: Xá Phó houses in thôn Nậm Sang, about 2.5 km from the Nậm Sài commune center and about 30 km south of town. It is a home meal, not a restaurant.
seoTitle: Fish in bamboo at Nam Sang — a Xa Pho home meal
seoDescription: Cá lam ống, fish cooked in bamboo, at Xá Phó family meals in thôn Nậm Sang, about 30 km south of Sa Pa.
